title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy of a 365 Day Firm Transportation Agreement with Jefferson Smurfit Corporation.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul B. Vasington, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 02-15)
